frameworks.name: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) / google-genai
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: First-class multimodal function calling, structured schema outputs, sessions
frameworks.interoperability: Native to Gemini ecosystem and Antigravity core
frameworks.mcpSupport: Direct MCP client and tool adapter support
frameworks.toolCalling: Automatic type-safe schema generation from Python types / JSON Schema
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Primary AI engine framework for all structured LLM inferences

frameworks.name: PydanticAI
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: Model-agnostic agent execution with dependency injection and type validation
frameworks.interoperability: High; works seamlessly across Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, and local models
frameworks.memory: Clean state passing and message history management
frameworks.toolCalling: Best-in-class Pydantic schema validation and static typing
frameworks.multiAgentSupport: Programmatic agent delegation via tool calls
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Recommended framework whenever user tasks request typed Python agent pipelines
frameworks.integrationDecision: APPROVED_LIBRARY: Integrated for typed agent workflows

frameworks.name: LangGraph
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: Stateful multi-actor graph execution with cycles, branches, and human-in-the-loop gates
frameworks.interoperability: Python & TypeScript, integrates with LangChain ecosystem
frameworks.memory: Persistent state checkpoints and time-travel debugging
frameworks.productionMaturity: Production ready for complex cyclical workflows
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Do not replace Antigravity native router. Use as an external library when the user explicitly requests cyclic state machines or time-travel persistence.
frameworks.integrationDecision: EXTERNAL_ADAPTER: Preserved for user-specified cyclical workflows

frameworks.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: Lightweight handoff patterns, agent boundaries, guardrails, and tracing
frameworks.interoperability: Focused on OpenAI models; requires adapter for other providers
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Clean architectural concepts for handoffs; redundant with Antigravity's native invoke_subagent and send_message
frameworks.integrationDecision: EXTERNAL_ADAPTER: Available for OpenAI-specific project requirements

frameworks.name: Microsoft AutoGen
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: Conversational multi-agent group chats and event-driven actor framework
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Antigravity's native subagents provide lighter, zero-dependency orchestration without AutoGen's complex async event bus
frameworks.integrationDecision: REJECTED — DUPLICATE CAPABILITY of native Antigravity subagent bus

frameworks.name: CrewAI
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: Role-playing autonomous agents collaborating through crews and tasks
frameworks.memory: Short-term, long-term, and entity memory stores
frameworks.productionMaturity: Moderate; heavy abstractions and frequent breaking changes
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Direct duplicate of Antigravity's existing 20+ specialized agent personas. Adds heavyweight dependencies with zero net capability gain.
frameworks.integrationDecision: REJECTED — DUPLICATE CAPABILITY of native specialist personas

frameworks.name: Microsoft Semantic Kernel
frameworks.orchestrationCapability: Enterprise plugin orchestration, planning, and memory connectors
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Quality score (74/100) below threshold. Heavy enterprise abstraction layer that conflicts with Antigravity's lightweight, surgical diff posture.
frameworks.integrationDecision: REJECTED — BELOW QUALITY THRESHOLD & EXCESSIVE ABSTRACTION

frameworks.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
frameworks.usefulnessInAntigravity: Not ready for production engineering. Monitored for future capability updates.
frameworks.integrationDecision: REJECTED — BELOW QUALITY THRESHOLD & EARLY STAGE
